descFull: An MCP server that gives your AI agent agentic RAG over your PDFs, one file or a whole folder: hybrid semantic + keyword search, selective page reads, tables, images, OCR, chart data, and multi-column/CJK layouts. The agent decides when to search; pdf-mcp does the retrieval.
